# Read of unit U3, goal the-box-clock-counts-only-the-goals-own-work (round 2)

Subject: candidate diff /Users/wido/.metasystem/unit/20261109t072800-97c931d4fe/round-2/worktree.diff
(SHA-256 3fd266709016727d81c75fabf1477db95e10f59fa55d0db85cff686cf8cfe320) against base 0b24170ff68b,
judged against the build brief (unit brief + correction 1). The prepared copy equals the candidate:
`git apply --check -R worktree.diff` succeeds on it. No earlier read of this unit exists (round 1 stopped
in its check, reads null), so there are no prior findings to relate to.

## Verdict

AGREE. No material findings.

## What was checked

Checklist 1 (diff against the brief), item by item:

1. launch.go: `StateEnv = "METASYSTEM_LAUNCH_STATE"` beside `KindEnv`, appended with `stateDir` (the
   `m.Store.StateDir(id)` of :395) at Supervise. Present.
2. testenv.go: the name joins `inheritedControlNames` in alphabetical order. Present.
3. host_wait_record.go: `SlotWaitLine` with the specified JSON tags; `withSlotWaitRecord` returns ctx
   unchanged for an empty destination; `recordSlotWait` does one O_APPEND|O_CREATE|O_WRONLY 0600 write
   and drops every error; pid only on start lines; RFC3339Nano UTC; `SlotWaitHeld` refuses a non-base
   name or a name without `wait-`, else `heldByAnother`. Present.
4. Hooks: start right after `holdWaitMarker` succeeds (only when the marker is first created); end in
   the deferred release before `os.Remove`; the defer runs on success and every give-up; the function
   never reassigns `ctx` between 905 and 1160, so the end line always sees the destination. Only
   `AcquireHostResourcesWithWaitCheck` reads the variable, and every production caller
   (`AcquireHostResources`, proof_run.go, test.go, lane_room.go, candidateengine, testrun, devgate)
   routes through it. Inner signatures unchanged. Import of internal/launch builds (no cycle).
5. budget_provider.go: `launch`, `running` on launch dependencies only. Present.
6. Reader (budget_slot_wait.go `creditedSlotWaits`): not-found and empty file are silent; any other
   read error is one problem; bad decode, bad kind, empty marker, bad time, end with no start, end
   before start, duplicate start or end each credit nothing for the line or marker and give one problem
   line per file; paired waits credited; open waits credited to now only when running and held, else one
   problem naming launch and marker; clipped to [from, until]; markers kept in file order (correction 1).
   Never sets `ElapsedLegacy`.
7. budget.go: `netSlotWaits` right after `providerWaits`, per execution, pieces keep id/runtime/
   executed/launch/running; non-launch dependencies pass through; the netted deps feed both
   `cutPersonWork` and `ownWorkElapsed` in the block both lenses share (S6); `providerWaits`' spans are
   computed on the raw dependencies as before.
8. Seats: `entry.IsDir()` skipped; the seat launch's waits read with `running` = no reapedAt and no
   terminal launch; occupancy cut by environment intervals, the goal's launch waits and every seat's
   credited waits through one helper (`cutWorkSpans`), matching D4's "every confirmed slot wait of the
   goal"; seat occupancy still never reaches `cutPersonWork`.
9. D9: two `json:"-"` fields; set only when the own-work value stands (S4); `SlotWords` in
   `PersonWords`' shape; printed after `PersonWords` at both cmd sites.
Correction 1: the two retry tests compare environments without `StateEnv` entries, require exactly one
entry per command and distinct values (the person-retry test against both earlier commands); no other
assertion changed.
The changed existing test `TestOwnWorkSeatFailuresKeepTheLegacyClock` "record" row now writes a
malformed file instead of a directory; required by item 8's IsDir skip, and the fallback it pins still
holds. Nothing outside the brief changed.

Whole-chain checks for regressions the brief does not name:
- A per-launch value in every launch environment could have broken test-result reuse. It does not:
  the test-run environment is the allowlist of `testrun.Environment` / `InheritedEnvironment`
  (contract.go:203-248), which never carries METASYSTEM_LAUNCH_STATE, so `digestEnvironment` keys are
  unchanged.
- The unit check's frozen environment (captured from the `work build` process) can carry an outer
  launch's StateEnv; Supervise appends the proof launch's own value last, `childEnvironment` keeps both
  overrides in order, and `exec.Cmd` keeps the last duplicate, so the check's acquisition (in the proof
  launch child, which carries `Goal: plan.Goal`, unit_run.go:662) records under its own launch.
- No production code compares launch command environments (only the two retry tests did).
- No goal-tagged launch kind wraps the unit runner, so no outer goal interval masks the netted check.

Checklist 2 (tests exercise the changed behaviour): the proof command /usr/bin/true runs nothing; the
engine's frozen check selected and ran every new and changed test (output.log selection line), all
green, audits (`^TestAudit`, including the message and JSON-layout audits) green. The one red,
`TestPendingWaitFromChildShell` (supervision shutdown and a git probe), passed on its diagnostic rerun
and touches nothing in this diff. The new tests go well past the happy path: give-up, end-write
failure, no destination, probe refusal, lost end, terminal launch, probe error, file-order of two
problems over 128 projections, seven broken-file modes, a directory entry among seat records, the
person pause beside a wait checked in both lenses, and TC2 through `goal status` and `goal show` on
real launch records. I re-ran the new dispatch and proofrun tests on the prepared copy: ok. `go build
./...` and `go vet` of the four internal packages: ok.

## Non-gating observations

1. internal/dispatch/budget_slot_wait.go: the open-wait problem line says "has no end and no held
   marker for a running launch" also when the marker is held but the launch is terminal (T20 third row).
   The time correctly counts; only the reason in the words is imprecise. Impact-free.
2. internal/dispatch/budget_slot_wait_test.go: no row has an open held wait under a seat whose launch is
   terminal or reaped (the seat-side `running` false); the launch-side equivalent is pinned by T20's
   terminal row and the seat code uses the same helper. Not required by the brief.

## Not checked within the budget

- `go run ./cmd/devgate static`, the rule-13 pinning-test sweep and whole-package runs were not
  repeated by this read; the engine's frozen check covered the selected impact set.
- The builder's mutation runs (t)-(ai) were not re-executed; their sensitivity was judged by reading
  the tests against the code.

VERDICT: land
